context_notes: Mid-discussion of Phase 5, 2/4 selected gray areas resolved. Framing that MUST carry into planning: (1) the ROADMAP Phase 5 text is STALE — it says Stripe/reverse_transfer/account.updated, but D-20 makes this PayMongo (collect full -> platform wallet -> HOLD -> after-session inhouse POST /v2/batch_transfers of booking - commission; a pre-payout refund is just a platform-wallet refund since the host isn't paid yet; account.updated = the merchant.activated webhook already built in Phase 2). (2) Phase 5 is payment infra on the SINGLE non-forked path; the instant vs request-to-book fork + authorize->capture + host approve/decline are Phase 6. (3) Phase 7 owns cancellation-policy tiers, so Phase 5 builds the refund/dispute MECHANISM not the policy matrix. Recommended-but-not-yet-accepted directions for the open areas: Payout timing = T+24h after session end via a scheduled batch sweep (fits PayMongo's batch_transfers API + STATE 'don't over-build'); Payment wiring depth = the charge replaces the Phase-4 placeholder confirm and confirm becomes webhook-driven (booking confirms on payment.paid, not the synchronous return).
